authority_classes.OWNER_METADATA: Dataset-owner or repository-owner machine-readable/landing metadata (Zenodo record, UCI page/API, Mendeley deposit).
authority_classes.OWNER_PAPER_ABSTRACT: Article front matter or abstract authored by the dataset owners (Highlights, abstract, introduction, ethics/data-availability statements).
authority_classes.SECONDARY_PAPER: Peer-reviewed third-party analysis or reanalysis; corroborates or conflicts but cannot authenticate original acquisition.
authority_classes.SECONDARY_PAPER_EXCERPT_ONLY: Third-party text reached only as a published excerpt/search-index snippet; not full-text verified.
authority_classes.HISTORICAL_LOCAL_AGGREGATE: Previously recorded maintainer-executed read-only aggregate observation already in the repository; not re-derived here.
authority_classes.REPOSITORY_CONTRACT: Frozen versioned artifact in this repository, inspected read-only.

findings.question_or_claim: Do the original sources report 413 patients or 413 videos, and is the relationship established?
findings.access_observation: All three owner sources read on 2026-11-19 (record API, PubMed abstract, ScienceDirect preview).
supporting_evidence: Zenodo description: 'video frames from 413 patients'
PubMed abstract and ScienceDirect abstract/Introduction/Conclusion: 'structured clinical data from 413 patients', 'XRA video sequences from 413 patients'
ScienceDirect Highlights bullet 1: '413 X-ray coronary angiography videos with expert annotations and clinical data'
conflicting_evidence: Third-party preprint excerpt states AngioCAD 'full cohort (n=412)' and a valid-views subset n=326 (SECONDARY_PAPER_EXCERPT_ONLY; not full-text verified)
verified: Two author-reported counts exist and are published in different parts of the same article (abstract vs Highlights).
The Zenodo record description uses the patient count (413 patients) and reports no video/study count.
unresolved: patient-to-video mapping: UNKNOWN_NOT_ESTABLISHED
actual number of videos/studies in the archive
whether 413 is an analyzable per-patient row count in either spreadsheet
findings.scientific_or_technical_consequence: Neither count may be restated as a file-level fact. Any manuscript sentence must attribute the count to the specific location it came from, as already done after PR #100.
findings.owner_evidence_required: Published manifest with per-patient video/study counts and the mapping rule.

access_right 'open'; license.id 'cc-by-4.0'.

No data dictionary, codebook, README or schema file exists in the record.

verified: Structured tabular files exist, in XLSX format.

row counts, sheet names, headers, dtypes, missingness
whether an XLSX-level data dictionary is embedded inside the workbooks

findings.question_or_claim: Can pre-angiography clinical/laboratory predictors be separated from post-catheterization angiography/stenosis material?
findings.access_observation: Record description, abstract, Introduction and Ethics statement readable; dataset section paywalled.
supporting_evidence: Record: annotations are artery-level stenosis labels in seven severity categories over X-ray angiography frames extracted from DICOM.
Ethics: data 'retrospectively collected from Shahid Chamran Heart Center (Isfahan, Iran)'.
No accessible statement gives any acquisition time for clinical or laboratory fields.
conflicting_evidence: The Introduction's generic sentence 'CAD is generally diagnosed when there is >50% blockage' could be misread as a dataset label definition; it is textbook framing.
verified: The imaging and stenosis/label layer is post-catheterization by construction.
Collection was retrospective.
No pre-angiography acquisition moment is documented for any tabular field.
unresolved: whether any tabular field was recorded before the procedure
the patient-level binary CAD target (existence, threshold, adjudication, class counts)
findings.scientific_or_technical_consequence: AngioCAD's imaging/stenosis task is a distinct post-catheterization research task, not the CardioAssist Track A target; its tabular layer cannot yet cross the pre-procedure boundary.
findings.owner_evidence_required: Per-field acquisition chronology and the patient-level label definition with class counts.

findings.question_or_claim: Why do original author sources report 54 features while historical local evidence reports 55 predictors plus Cath?
findings.access_observation: UCI page and API, Mendeley page, 2013 abstract and the 2022 secondary paper were read on 2026-11-19.

which reading (H-56 or H-55) is correct

The same paragraph spells the field 'External CP', a field-level reliability signal.

question_updates.proposed_evidence_text: Owner machine-readable field metadata verified empty (UCI API num_features 0; 56 blank variable objects). BP quantity and PR units/conditions therefore cannot be resolved from public metadata; the six 0/1 directions remain provisional (S-9) because the cited secondary Table 1 could not be re-retrieved this pass. Owner codebook or author statement required.

2022 Electronics §3 and §4.1 re-verified: Exertional CP constant across that copy's 303 samples and then dropped; delivery/hash unspecified; the same paragraph spells the field 'External CP'.
